_note: summary?event= trimmed 2026-09-22 for the MLS detail parser: 655997 is the 2022 MLS Cup (3-3, LAFC on penalties), 761829 a 2026 league match. keyEvents in full, the first roster entry of each side with every key, the boxscore player keys, and the summary top keys.

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Jack Elliott (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal!  Los Angeles Football Club 1, Philadelphia Union 0. Kellyn Acosta (Los Angeles Football Club) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Los Angeles Football Club 1, Philadelphia Union 0.

Goal!  Los Angeles Football Club 1, Philadelphia Union 1. Dániel Gazdag (Philadelphia Union) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by José Martínez   following a corner.
José Cifuentes (Los Angeles Football Club) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Cory Burke replaces Mikael Uhre.
Substitution, Los Angeles Football Club. Kwadwo Opoku replaces Cristian Arango.

Goal!  Los Angeles Football Club 2, Philadelphia Union 1. Jesús Murillo (Los Angeles Football Club) with an attempt from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Carlos Vela with a cross   following a corner.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Paxten Aaronson replaces Jack McGlynn.

Goal!  Los Angeles Football Club 2, Philadelphia Union 2. Jack Elliott (Philadelphia Union) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Kai Wagner with a cross   following a set piece situation.
Sebastien Ibeagha (Los Angeles Football Club) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Julián Carranza (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Los Angeles Football Club 2, Philadelphia Union 2.
Substitution, Los Angeles Football Club. Cristian Tello replaces Kellyn Acosta.
Substitution, Los Angeles Football Club. Gareth Bale replaces Carlos Vela.
First Half Extra Time ends, Los Angeles Football Club 2, Philadelphia Union 2.
Second Half Extra Time begins Los Angeles Football Club 2, Philadelphia Union 2.
Maxime Crépeau (Los Angeles Football Club) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Los Angeles Football Club. John McCarthy replaces Kwadwo Opoku.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Chris Donovan replaces Cory Burke because of an injury.
Goal!  Los Angeles Football Club 2, Philadelphia Union 3. Jack Elliott (Philadelphia Union) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner    following a corner.
Goal!  Los Angeles Football Club 3, Philadelphia Union 3. Gareth Bale (Los Angeles Football Club) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Diego Palacios with a cross.
Second Half Extra Time ends, Los Angeles Football Club 3, Philadelphia Union 3.
